title: Puthoff and Davis describe how the legacy UFO program recruits

tellings.quote:
But it was just
that you would have to first apply to an
aerospace corporation, one of the major
ones that are, you know, implicated as
one of being part of the legacy program,

plain: To join the "legacy program", a supposed long-running secret effort to study crashed or recovered craft, a person is said to first have to apply for a job at one of the big aerospace companies thought to be part of it. An unnamed researcher says this is what he was told by two physicists, Hal Puthoff and Eric W. Davis. If true, these companies would be the front door to the program.
